config.default_sync_note: Default policy synchronized to independently selected validation parameters after evaluation; all episodes explicitly supplied the same selected parameters.

conclusion: Study 1: the optimized nominal policy exactly matched query information gain per cost. Study 2: validity-aware experiment selection reduced weak-confounding false claims from 21/96 to 6/96 against the same-guard nominal acquisition; it tied validity decision-value and did not improve the stronger unseen-negative scenario.
